English: Spindle Patch
A simple area strewn with stones and woven mats, where the first Dravidian weavers gather to work with raw fibers. A humble, mobile workspace for clan crafters.
Weavers Tent
A large, sturdy tent for skilled weavers, offering shelter from the elements and space for communal spinning and weaving. Slightly improves clan unity and production.
Loom Hut
A sturdier, semi-permanent hut constructed of wood and mud, housing upright looms. Increases weaving output and supports a larger nomad population.
Patterned Room
A decorated, well-ventilated room for artisans, where patterns and advanced techniques are developed. Fosters innovation and population growth.
Dye Pavilion
A specialized pavilion for preparing vibrant natural dyes and treating cloth, requiring skilled workers. The presence of such a facility draws more artisans and boosts prosperity.
Textile Chamber
A large, fortified structure with many looms and workspaces for complex textiles, drawing master weavers and apprentices from distant clans.
Fine Cloth Hall
A prestigious hall where the finest Dravidian cloth is crafted and displayed. The halls renown attracts merchants and increases trade and unity.
Weavers Guildhall
A grand guildhall for the most skilled weavers and textile masters, guiding apprentices, setting standards, and strengthening clan bonds and prosperity.
Master Weavers Room
A lavish, private chamber for the most renowned master weavers, where rare techniques are preserved and the next generation is mentored. Becomes a symbol of Dravidian innovation.
Dravidian Weaving Guild

The legendary heart of Dravidian textile mastery, gathering the greatest weavers, merchants, and innovators under one roof. Immense prosperity, unity, and prestige flow from this unparalleled institution.
